subject.title: chore: migrate active GPT-5.5 references to GPT-5.6

question: Should OpenClaw adopt GPT-5.6 Sol as the active product default and GPT-5.6 Luna as the standard lower-cost QA and release model after the catalog defect and conflicts are repaired?
rationale: This PR intentionally changes user-facing defaults and maintainer model-routing policy across many surfaces; correctness review can identify defects, but a maintainer must own the permanent Sol/Luna product and cost split.

options.title: Adopt the Sol/Luna split
options.body: Approve the proposed routing direction after Terra fallback parity, semantic conflict resolution, and exact-head validation are complete.

options.title: Keep GPT-5.5 defaults for now
options.body: Limit this PR to non-default examples or close it until the release train is ready to change active product and automation selections.

options.title: Narrow the migration
options.body: Move only product defaults or only QA/release workloads now and track the remaining routing class separately.

recommendation.title: Adopt the Sol/Luna split
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed routing direction after Terra fallback parity, semantic conflict resolution, and exact-head validation are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue, PR, assignment, current-main history, and relevant default/catalog work all point to steipete as the best available owner for this model-direction decision.
